vintage: Fiches géographiques ISPF, recensement de la population de Polynésie française 2022, legal deposit 2024-02-07
methodology: Commune-level tables from the 2022 French Polynesia census geographic workbooks are distributed over commune polygons and summed within each hex. Values cover only French Polynesia; the rest of France is null because these are territory-specific tables.
